arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Unikowsky argued the side that brought the case received nothing from the sales.
He stated the government seeks to hold him liable for the full amount.
He claimed this position contradicts the text and purpose of the statute.
Justice Alito asked how the rule would work in drug conspiracy cases.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the scope of federal forfeiture law. the side that brought the case argues the statute limits seizure to proceeds a defendant actually received. The government argues the statute covers all proceeds from the conspiracy.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case determines how much money the government can seize from criminal conspiracies. It affects the financial liability of every member of a group crime. It defines the scope of federal forfeiture power in multi-defendant cases.
